honor: Officer of the Order of Orange-Nassau (Officier in de Orde van Oranje-Nassau)
detail: Listed in the Staatscourant among the royal decorations of 2 September 2024 for departing members of the fourth Rutte cabinet, as 'oud-vice-minister-president en oud-minister voor Klimaat en Energie'.

honor: Grand Cross of the Order of Civil Merit (Gran Cruz de la Orden del Mérito Civil)
awarded_by: King Felipe VI of Spain (Real Decreto 377/2024)
detail: Conferred by royal decree of 9 April 2024, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado, on Jetten as Minister for Climate and Energy Policy and Deputy Prime Minister, together with other Dutch office holders.

honor: Grand Cordon of the Order of the Rising Sun (旭日大綬章)
detail: Listed by the Cabinet Office of Japan among foreign recipients of decorations dated 5 June 2026, as Prime Minister and Minister of General Affairs, in a group with members of the Dutch royal house, the foreign minister, the presiding officers of both chambers and other Dutch officials.
